task_title: CF-307 check_scan_scope must not report green when it could not read the scan surface
task_criteria: Every unreadable, dangling-symlink, wrong-root or absent scan surface is a named FAIL with exit 2 (never 'no posture docs found' with exit 0); a genuinely empty surface stays distinguishable from unreadable; fixtures cover mode-000 dir, dangling symlink, wrong root depth and empty surface; the real repo still exits 0 with 15 claims; bash tests/selftest.sh passes.

items.criterion: Every unreadable, dangling-symlink, wrong-root or absent scan surface is a named FAIL with exit 2 (never 'no posture docs found' with exit 0); a genuinely empty surface stays distinguishable from unreadable; fixtures cover mode-000 dir, dangling symlink, wrong root depth and empty surface; the real repo still exits 0 with 15 claims; bash tests/selftest.sh passes.
items.detail: The gate behaviour and fixtures are all delivered and verified, but the last clause — 'bash tests/selftest.sh passes' — is not met. Three independent full runs of the configured test command (`.gitreins/config.yaml: test_command: bash tests/selftest.sh`) each ended `SELFTEST: FAIL (1)` (runs at /tmp/selftest3.out, /tmp/selftest4.out, /tmp/selftest5.out, ~2.5 min each). The single counted failure is section 51: `FAIL  tracked python surface is red: a python-staging commit is refused` (tests/selftest.sh:4799-4803 runs `ruff check $(git ls-files '*.py')`), from 5 pre-existing findings — F811 scripts/build_book.py:430, F841 scripts/gen_handbook_figures.py:89, E741 at :217/:232/:245 — confirmed present at the task commit itself (`git show b52df08:scripts/build_book.py | grep -n 'def svg_fit'` -> 59 and 430) and still present at HEAD 6447606 (`ruff check $(git ls-files '*.py')` -> `Found 5 errors`). The commit message discloses this red, but the criterion states the suite passes, and it does not. Everything else in the criterion PASSES with evidence: `python3 scripts/check_scan_scope.py` -> `OK  audit-scope: 15 gitleaks claim(s) name their --log-opts` / `RESULT: OK`, exit 0; `python3 -B tests/test_scan_scope.py -v` -> `Ran 7 tests ... OK` (uid 1000, so the mode-000 arm is genuinely measurable); scripts/check_scan_scope.py:63-95 raises UnreadablePath for missing/not-a-dir/permission-denied docs/audits and for dangling symlinks, main() maps it to `FAIL  audit-scope: <path> <reason>` + `RESULT: FAIL (unreadable path)` + return 2 (lines 168-172), the empty-but-read case prints its own sentence `audit surface read, 0 posture docs` with exit 0 (line 183-184), and the old 'no posture docs found' wording is gone (grep finds it only in the tests' assertNotIn guards); selftest rows `PASS  scan scope names every surface outcome (unreadable != empty)`, `PASS  posture docs name their scan scope`, `PASS  unscoped claim -> FAIL audit-scope`, `PASS  scoped claim -> OK` all appear in every run.
